idea-plugin.name: Git Worktree Manager
idea-plugin.description:
Git Worktree Manager — create and manage git worktrees without leaving the IDE

A tool window and VCS menu actions for git worktree: create a worktree from an existing branch or with a new branch, open it in a new window, copy its path, remove it (with a force fallback for dirty trees) and prune stale references.

Features

  • Create from existing branch — pick a local or remote branch and a destination path
  • Create with a new branch — name the branch, pick its base and check it out into a new worktree
  • Worktrees tool window — every worktree of the repository, main worktree highlighted, locked/prunable badges
  • Open, copy path, remove, prune — from the tool window toolbar; double-click opens a worktree
  • Settings — default base directory, what to do after creating a worktree, remove confirmation

Works in every JetBrains IDE. Requires git on the PATH. Also available for VS Code as JSG Git Worktree Manager.
